mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_mapping_scope (tenant_id,legal_entity_id,currency) SELECT #{tenant},#{entity},#{currency} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_mapping_scope WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND legal_entity_id=#{legalEntityId} AND currency=#{expectedCurrency})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM account_mapping_draft WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND mapping_key=#{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE account_mapping_draft SET name=#{name},revision=#{revision},state_json=#{stateJson},updated_by=#{userId},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND mapping_key=#{key} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND published_version=#{publishedVersion}

UPDATE account_mapping_draft SET published_version=#{version},published_draft_revision=#{revision},state_json=#{stateJson} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND mapping_key=#{key} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND published_version=#{publishedVersion}

UPDATE account_mapping_scope SET active_revision=#{activeRevision},active_mapping_id=#{mappingId},active_mapping_version=#{version} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND legal_entity_id=#{legalEntityId} AND currency=#{currency} AND active_revision=#{expectedActiveRevision}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM account_mapping_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND mapping_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}

SELECT version,draft_revision,category_revision,name,target_digest,published_by,published_at,comment FROM account_mapping_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND mapping_id=#{id} AND version<#{before} ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM account_mapping_draft_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND mapping_id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision}
